title: 第3275章 残魂索命怨气冲天第3274章 怨气冲天
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
那片厂房距离龙婆的别墅不远，位于整个村寨中心区域。
两份雷火符同时引爆，让上方的房屋因剧烈震动而坍塌，瞬间吸引了所有人的注意。
这一刻，方淼淼、保镖和苏晚棠的脸上，都露出真实的惊愕。
虽然已经得到了秦伏天的提醒，可他们怎么也没想到，秦伏天说的两分钟后会发生的事情，居然是爆炸。
看规模，炸弹的威力显然不小。
可仅仅一个厂房坍塌而已，真的能化解他们这次的危机吗？
方淼淼觉得不行，忍不住在心中摇了摇头。
秦伏天还是太天真了啊，这个时候发生爆炸，只会让敌人更加警惕、戒备。
方淼淼无奈地想着，刚打算说点什么转移其他人的注意力，就见爆炸的地方突然涌出一片黑红色的烟雾。
“哈哈哈哈！”
“桀桀桀！”
“死！都给我死啊！死！”
一道道狰狞得看不清容貌的残魂，从那爆炸的废墟中冲了出来，扑向寨子中的众人。
血红的眼睛与满身的煞气，足以让普通人胆寒。
“啊！这是什么东西？”
“砰砰砰！”
惨叫声不断传来，火力朝着残魂倾泻而出，却没有对残魂带来任何伤害。
反倒是那些被残魂扑倒的人，生命气息快速消失，很快就变成一具被鬼气污染的尸体，倒在地上。
他们的双眼充血，直到生命的最后一刻都在惊恐地望着前方，死不瞑目。
诡异凄厉的惨状吓了所有人一跳，原本应该朝着秦伏天一行人包围过来的人，再也顾不得其他，仓皇逃命。

“鬼！有鬼啊！快跑！”
惊恐的声音在村寨中响起。
稍稍了解过一点皮毛的人看到这一幕，更加震惊，跑得也更快。
因为出现这种超出常理认知的事情，要么说明敌人打过来了，要么说明自家的鬼修玩砸了。
与华夏相邻一带的国家，全都受过华夏传统文化的影响，太清楚一点鬼怪失控普通人会是什么下场，他们怎么可能不怕？
“开门，等事情平息之后再说。”
秦伏天冷淡的声音将门口的其他人惊醒。
方淼淼又惊又怕，朝守卫喝道：“开门！那些鬼东西连坐镇这里的强者都无法解决，你们更不是对手。再不开门，所有人都得死在这！”
旁边的小弟也害怕地劝道：“大哥，先开门吧。她是方家的人，如果她真的杀了龙婆，上面自然有人去找方家算账，我们没必要把自己的小命搭进去。”
另一名小弟低声道：“大哥，我们要是跑出去了，等支援的大人赶过来还能为大人提供情报。如果所有人都死在这，恐怕连个报信的都没有。”
找到逃跑的借口，众守卫终究不打算将自己的命搭进去，甚至没等人下令，就已合力将出口打开。
其他正在逃跑的人见状，一窝蜂朝这边涌来。
眼看无力阻挡，拦截方淼淼的人才像是被裹挟似的，与方淼淼对视一眼，默契上了车。
content_en:
The factory building is not far from Long Po's villa and is located in the center of the entire village.
Two thunder and fire talismans detonated at the same time, causing the house above to collapse due to violent vibrations, instantly attracting everyone's attention.
At this moment, Fang Miaomiao, the bodyguards and Su Wantang all had real shock on their faces.
Although they had been reminded by Qin Futian, they never expected that what Qin Futian said would happen in two minutes would actually be an explosion.
Looking at the scale, the bomb was obviously quite powerful.
But just the collapse of a factory building, can it really resolve their crisis this time?
Fang Miaomiao felt that it was not possible and couldn't help but shook her head in her heart.
Qin Futian was still too naive. An explosion at this time would only make the enemy more vigilant and alert.
Fang Miaomiao thought helplessly. Just as he was about to say something to divert the attention of others, he saw a black-red smoke suddenly pouring out from the place where the explosion occurred.
"Hahahaha!"
"Jie Jie Jie!"
"Die! Die! Die!"
Remaining souls that were so ferocious that their appearance could not be seen rushed out from the ruins of the explosion and pounced on the people in the village.
His blood-red eyes and evil spirit all over his body are enough to make ordinary people tremble.
"Ah! What is this?"
"Bang bang bang!"
Screams kept coming, and firepower poured out towards the remnant soul, but it did not cause any harm to the remnant soul.
On the contrary, those who were knocked down by the remnant souls had their life breath disappear quickly and soon turned into corpses contaminated by ghost energy and fell to the ground.
Their eyes were bloodshot, and they stared ahead in horror until the last moment of their lives.
The strange and tragic scene shocked everyone. The people who were supposed to surround Qin Futian and his party could no longer care about anything else and ran for their lives in a hurry.
"Ghost! There is a ghost! Run!"
Frightened sounds echoed in the village.
People who had a little knowledge of it were even more shocked when they saw this scene and ran faster.
Because something like this beyond common sense occurs, it either means that the enemy is coming, or that your own ghost cultivator has messed up.
Countries adjacent to China have all been influenced by Chinese traditional culture. They know very well what will happen to ordinary people if ghosts get out of control. How can they not be afraid?
"Open the door and wait until things calm down."
Qin Futian's cold voice woke up the others at the door.
Fang Miaomiao was shocked and scared, and shouted to the guard: "Open the door! Even the strong men sitting here can't deal with those ghosts, and you are no match. If you don't open the door, everyone will die here!"
The younger brother next to him also advised in fear: "Brother, please open the door first. She is from the Fang family. If she really kills Long Po, someone above will naturally go to the Fang family to settle the score. There is no need for us to risk our own lives."
Another younger brother whispered: "Brother, if we run out, we can still provide information to you when the supporting adults arrive. If everyone dies here, I'm afraid there won't even be one to report the news."
After finding an excuse to escape, the guards did not intend to risk their lives after all. They worked together to open the exit without even waiting for an order.
The other people who were running away saw this and swarmed towards this direction.
Seeing that he was unable to stop him, the man who intercepted Fang Miaomiao looked at Fang Miaomiao and got into the car with a tacit understanding as if he was being coerced.
